info.name: Get product counts for a Product Group

params.name: product_group_id
params.description: Unique identifier of a product group

params.name: ad_account_id
params.description: Unique identifier of an ad account.

items.docs: Get a product counts for a given Catalogs Product Group owned by the "operation user_account". - By default, the "operation user_account" is the token user_account. Optional: Business Access: Specify an ad_account_id (obtained via List ad accounts) to use the owner of that ad_account as the "operation user_account".
